title: Moving off a deactivated term: how the note names the old term
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • Make sure the shop's own term A (made for this test), due 60 days after the invoice date, is deactivated and held only by customer A (made for this test).
  • Note your user name.
  • Make sure Net 30 is active.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "Inactive" tab.
  2. Click the "⋯" at the right of the term A row.
  3. Click "Move Customers".
  4. Choose "Net 30" in "Move To".
  5. Click "Move 1 Customer".
  6. Open customer A's customer page.
  7. Click the "Notes" tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Term A is listed.

Step 2:

  • The menu opens.

Step 3:

  • The window "Move Customers from term A" opens with customer A ticked.

Step 4:

  • The dropdown shows Net 30.

Step 5:

  • The toast "1 customer moved to Net 30." shows.

Step 6:

  • The page opens.

Step 7:

  • The note reads "Credit term changed from term A to Net 30 by your user name (Move Customers)." — or with "term A (Inactive)", as the PO answers (see the note).

The PRD does not say whether a deactivated term is named plainly or with "(Inactive)" in the note and the log. Question 5 on Chris Ward's sheet (shared with him 23 Oct 2026) asks; this case is held until he answers.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers)

  • S4-R11: “Each moved customer gets a note on its Notes, authored by the user who moved it, reading "Credit term changed from {old term} to {new term} by {user name} (Move Customers)." A customer moved from a blank term reads "from COD".”
  • S4-N3: “Inactive terms and Credit Hold are valid sources (Move Customers is how a shop empties a deactivated term). Inactive terms are never offered in "Move To".”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
